title: Do not rely on the gate wrapper to restore missing Claude rows
description: A feature-off cache contains a post-filtered model list, so `GatedModelsManager` cannot reconstruct chat-only Claude rows after the gate turns on.
resolution: The plan chooses cache identity mismatch before applying cached models as the exact fix seam and explicitly avoids picker/wrapper filter changes.

title: Preserve steady-state cache hits
description: A gate-aware cache fix could accidentally bypass the 300s TTL benefit on every startup if it forces refetches unconditionally.
resolution: Acceptance criteria and tests now require a matching identity fresh cache to avoid a second fetch.

title: Patch-surface documentation is required for upstream-canonical edits
description: The fix edits upstream-canonical codex-rs crates, so codex fork guidance requires SANDBOX PATCH markers and patch-surface documentation.
resolution: The plan includes `codex/docs/implementation/patch-surface.md` and explicit SANDBOX PATCH documentation acceptance criteria.
